content:
Factor \(4040=2^3\cdot 5\cdot 101\). The largest possible \(n\) must satisfy \(n(n+1)\le 4040\), so \(n\le 63\). Divisors of \(4040\) up to 63 are \(1,2,4,5,8,10,20,40\); the largest is \(40\).

For \(n=40\):
\[
2a+n-1=\frac{4040}{40}=101
\]
\[
2a+39=101 \implies a=31
\]
So the 40 consecutive natural numbers are from 31 to 70.

\[
\boxed{2020=31+32+\cdots+70}
\]
